subject: Bedrock RFP — Key Management and Cross-Region Dataflow Evidence Request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bedrockfinancial.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bedrockfinancial.com
Date: 2027-08-01T14:12:00Z
Subject: Bedrock RFP – KMS key rotation + cross-region dataflow follow-up

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the intro last week. As part of Bedrock's RFP SIG/controls review (section 5), our InfoSec team has a few focused asks on key management and how keys are used across regions. Can you provide the following artifacts and clarifications?

- Key rotation policy excerpt and rotation schedule (automated/manual)
- Rotation logs for the last 90 days (redacted where necessary) or an example rotation event
- Architecture diagram showing cross-region dataflow where KMS keys are used (including which keys are region-scoped vs. global)
- Confirmation whether keys are HSM-backed and whether BYOK (customer-managed keys) is supported
- Sample CloudTrail query or log snippet that demonstrates a key rotation/disable event (redacted ok)
- Statement on split-key / envelope encryption practices, and any KMS wrapping key rotation cadence

We attached the RFP section for reference. Ideally we'd like a first pass by EOD Friday (Aug 6) so procurement can move forward.

Attachment: Bedrock_RFP_Section5.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful.

Samantha Lee
Senior InfoSec Partner
Bedrock Financial
Samantha.Lee@bedrockfinancial.com

Samantha,

Thanks — we've got this on our radar. Quick mutual action plan so expectations are clear:

Deliverables (first pass):
- redwood-kms-arch-diagram.png — Cross-region key/dataflow diagram (architect)
- kms-rotation-snippets.txt — Example rotation and CloudTrail snippets (ops/security)
- action-plan-bedrock-kms.xlsx — Artefact checklist + owners + delivery dates
- Control mapping: SIG v5.2 controls -> Redwood evidence pointers (Karthik will own)

Owners & proposed timeline:
- Mina Haddad: rotation logs, CloudTrail queries, operation runbook snippets (deliver by 2027-08-05 EOD)
- Karthik Iyer: control mapping document and an indexed evidence list (deliver by 2027-08-05 EOD)
- Ben Carter: confirm which deployment regions Bedrock's workloads will use and procurement touchpoints

A couple of clarifying Qs for your team (so we focus the right artifacts):
1) Are you evaluating SOC 2 + SIG v5.2 mapping specifically, or do you need ISO/other attestations surfaced here as well?
2) For rotation logs, do you need full event history or curated/redacted examples showing a complete rotate->re-encrypt event?

If that timeline looks tight, we can prioritize the architecture diagram and rotation example first and follow up with mapping.

Attachments planned: redwood-kms-arch-diagram.png (diagram), kms-rotation-snippets.txt (log snippets), action-plan-bedrock-kms.xlsx (MAP).

I'll drop these into the shared drive link below once Mina and Karthik upload.

Thanks — Evelyn

Evelyn / team — assigning owners and listing exact artifact formats we should produce for SIG/Q&A: 

Mina (ops/security) — please gather the following and upload to the Drive folder:
- Rotation policy excerpt (PDF) with section numbers clearly indicated for our crosswalk
- Rotation event examples: one full rotate event (timestamped), one scheduled auto-rotate event, and the corresponding CloudTrail/operation log snippet (redact ARNs as needed). Put these in kms-rotation-snippets.txt.
- Sample encrypted blob metadata (base64 truncated) and the KMS key ID used — useful for demonstrating key lifecycle metadata without exposing plaintext.

Ben (sales/eng) — confirm and record:
- Regions where Bedrock intends to run (list region codes) and whether they need cross-region key access or per-region keys.
- If Bedrock requests BYOK, we need to note the supported import formats and HSM attestations.

I'll produce: 
- Control mapping CSV: SIG control -> Redwood artifact filename -> owner -> redwood evidence rationale (upload by Aug 5)
- Short note on separation-of-duties (how key admin vs. operators vs. auditors are separated in our IAM/roles model).

Links for upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2C3-bedrock-rfp
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/BDRK-2027-1147 (I will attach the mapping to the deal record)

Target delivery: 2027-08-05 EOD. If anyone hits blockers, flag here immediately so I can escalate to infra.

Subject: Re: Bedrock RFP – KMS key rotation + cross-region dataflow follow-up

Evelyn / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turn. Aug 5 EOD is acceptable for a first packet. A couple quick clarifications so we can sign off the security section without follow-ups:

1) Split-key / envelope model: does Redwood support a customer-supplied wrap key (BYOK) where the wrapping key is only used for export/wrapping and never recorded persistently in your control plane? If so, can you include the import/rotation steps and any audit trails that show key import vs key use?

2) HSM attestations: if keys are HSM-backed, please include the vendor attestation/certificate you rely on (or state if managed cloud KMS is used with FIPS 140-2/3 validation).

3) Separation-of-duties: for key admins vs ops, a short bullet list of role names + example IAM policy names is enough for initial review. We may ask for more details in a subsequent round.

If possible, please put the artifacts into the Drive folder and ping procurement@bedrockfinancial.com when done. If there are any restrictions on sharing raw logs, we can accept time-windowed/redacted extracts.

Procurement contact for contracting questions: procurement@bedrockfinancial.com

Appreciate the responsiveness — Samantha

--
Samantha Lee
Senior InfoSec Partner
Bedrock Financial
